messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a rear-view dolly-in shot that moves from full-body to upper-body framing. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a rear-view dolly-in shot that moves from full-body to upper-body framing. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands facing the camera, then raises her right hand to brush her hair back and touch her face before lowering her arm and standing still again.","camera":"A low-angle, full-body shot that slowly dollies in to a medium close-up of her upper body and then back out.","clothing":"She wears a pink-and-white gingham off-the-shoulder top with white puffed sleeves, a white asymmetrical wrap skirt over black shorts, and light blue sneakers.","hair_color":"Reddish-orange.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled up into a tall, spiky topknot or mohawk-like style.","identity":"A dark-skinned woman with a slim build, shown from the front in a 3D-rendered style.","scene":"An outdoor fairground or amusement park with a striped carousel on the left, a wooden building and ride structure on the right, metal crowd-control barriers, and a pale sandy ground under a bright sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output now shows the woman from behind in the same fairground, starting in a full-body frame and dollying in to an upper-body/medium close-up. Her outfit, reddish hair, and hair-touching action remain recognizable, and the action progression roughly follows the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a rear-view dolly-in from full-body to upper-body framing, matching the reference's viewing direction, subject placement, and starting framing, while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, environment, and action timing.
uncertain: Whether the final framing is intended to be upper-body only or whether the pull-back is an acceptable part of the dolly movement.
Whether the changed background structures are an unintended scene alteration or an acceptable consequence of the rear-view camera direction.
unexpected_changes: The camera appears to pull back to a wider full-body framing near the end, rather than ending only on the requested upper-body framing.
The environment layout differs from the source: the large Ferris wheel and ticket booth are no longer the dominant background, replaced by a carousel on the left and different fairground structures.
The lighting and color grade appear brighter and more washed out than the source.
